newsitem.title: NORWAY: Stolt-Nielsen in Argentine terminal venture.
newsitem.headline: Stolt-Nielsen in Argentine terminal venture.

text.p: Stolt-Nielsen S.A., through its Stolthaven Terminals Division, and SOL Petroleo S.A have signed a letter of intent to form a joint venture to develop and operate a public tank storage terminal in Campana, Argentina, Stolt-Nielsen said on Monday.
It said in a statement to the Oslo Bourse that the new company, Stolthaven Campana, would be a combination of the existing Carboclor Industrias Quimicas storage facilities and new construction.
The company, which will be jointly owned, will be marketed and operated by Stolthaven Terminals. The terminal will have deep water access and operate 24 hours a day.
An extensive expansion of the terminal, scheduled for completion in May 1998, will begin immediately on completion of the joint venture agreement.
It will include an additional 32.800 cubic metres (32 tanks) of capacity, 7 new dock lines, expansion of the truck rack and sales, and a new drumming station, the statement said.
Another subsidiary of Stolt-Nielsen, Stolt Tankers Containers (STC) will build a full service cleaning station and repair depot in the terminal to service the Argentine market, the company said.
